_comment: Plain-language rendering of the engine verdict. Canonical EN text, shared by the .docx report and mirrored in frontend/src/i18n/locales/en.ts (a vitest checks the two agree). Sources: ILCD sentences follow D4.1 Part 1 §8 (Situation A/B/C1/C2 definitions and the substitution-vs-allocation rule); LCC sentences follow D4.2 §2 (C-LCC firm perspective, E-LCC value-chain perspective, S-LCC welfare perspective with Net Tax Factor). Pathway names are a T4.6 construct (ADR-005): the deliverables do not name IS-01..IS-05.

IS-01.title: Operational symbiosis — decision support
IS-01.body: A symbiotic exchange between two companies, or inside an eco-park, assessed to decide whether and how to run it.

IS-02.title: Sector-wide pre-feasibility — policy
IS-02.body: A policy or programme decision at regional or national scale, where the consequences are structural rather than marginal.

IS-03.title: Corporate contribution — reporting
IS-03.body: The symbiotic contribution of a single company inside a network, for ESG / CSRD reporting.

IS-04.title: Emerging IS network — ex-ante design
IS-04.body: A network still being designed, assessed on dynamic scenarios with no operating baseline.

IS-05.title: Monitoring — symbiosis in operation
IS-05.body: Time-series monitoring of an already operational symbiosis.

extendedSuffix: The assessment compares a baseline against alternative scenarios.

ilcd.ILCD Situation A: Micro-level decision support: the exchange is too small to change the background system. Attributional modelling, with substitution against the average market mix.
ilcd.ILCD Situation A multi-actor: Micro-level decision support across a multi-actor network: the same modelling rule as Situation A, applied to the whole park rather than to a single exchange.
ilcd.ILCD Situation B: Meso/macro-level decision support: the decision causes structural change in the background system, so consequential modelling against the marginal technology. D4.1 asks you to prove that scale before choosing it.
ilcd.ILCD Situation C1: Accounting with interactions — documenting what an existing network gives the wider economy. Substitution at the average market mix, as in Situation A.
ilcd.ILCD Situation C2: Strict accounting for one partner in isolation: allocation, and no substitution credits.

lcc.deactivated: No economic analysis — the economic dimension is off in Q3.
lcc.C+E: Conventional LCC (the firm's real cash flows) plus environmental LCC (the value chain, on the same boundary as the LCA).
lcc.C+E+S: Conventional and environmental LCC plus societal LCC: taxes and subsidies adjusted through the Net Tax Factor, environmental impacts monetised.
lcc.C-LCC: Conventional LCC only — the firm perspective, equivalent to a total cost of ownership analysis.

slca.active: S-LCA active: social indicators per stakeholder group.
slca.deactivated: S-LCA not activated — the social dimension is off in Q3.
